name: Clarify the symptom and treatment timeline
trigger: When symptoms change during or after an intervention.
action: Ask when each symptom began, when each intervention started, and what changed afterward. Record unknown dates explicitly.
decision_rule: Use the timeline to identify questions for further investigation; temporal association alone does not establish causation.
effect: Makes the chronology explicit before updating the differential diagnosis.
pitfall: Treating an unreported event as absent, or treating sequence as proof of causation.
example_status: Adapted illustration; not a measured experimental output
